messages:
Tess Morgan: Noticing a hole in telemetry hourly agg for `click_through` 2026-03-23 05:00-07:00 UTC (shards 12-13). Dashboard shows zeros.
Ravi Singh: I can repro. Likely late Kafka arrival from `ingest-omega`. Upstream changed normalization. Recommend slice-preview before any promote.
Diego Alvarez: Agreed. Let's run a 1-hour slice preview on shard 12 with emit_samples=5 and include invalidation preview. Need quota estimate in the output.
Tess Morgan: UX ask: console preview should show routing label + estimated CU and a tiny sample diff. Can we also expose expected wait time for selected quota_profile?
Ravi Singh: Internal API call: POST /reprocess {"range":"2026-03-23T05:00:00Z/2026-03-23T06:00:00Z","shards":[12],"preview":true,"emit_samples":5,"quota_profile":"background","emit_invalidation_preview":true}. I'll queue it now.
backfill-bot: Job created: preview-1718600000-012 (status: queued)
UI-bot: Noted: filing UI task to show quota_profile + est wait and small diff modal.
Ravi Singh: Preview finished. Checksum delta 0.12%. Sample diff: 4 rows mostly timestamp normalization. Invalidation keys: inv:click_through:shard:12:20260323T05. Estimated CU: 80, est wait (background): ~12m.
Diego Alvarez: 0.12% is small but above our 0.05% comfort for automatic promote. Let's schedule a targeted promote in off-peak with fair-share quota cap=300 and pre-promote smoke for first 10% shards.
Tess Morgan: I will schedule promote with `invalidate_on_promote=true`. Also adding an approval tag for manual sign-off because delta > 0.05%.
backfill-bot: Promote job queued: promote-1718600345-012 (status: queued)
Ravi Singh: Curl snippet (internal): curl -X POST https://internal-api/reprocess -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"range":"2026-03-23T05:00:00Z/2026-03-23T07:00:00Z","shards":[12,13],"preview":false,"quota":"fair-share","quota_cap":300,"invalidate_on_promote":true,"post_promote_smoke":true,"approval_tag":"manual-0.12"}'
Diego Alvarez: Monitoring after first 10% complete. If delta spikes >0.5% abort and notify data-platform.
Tess Morgan: Thanks team. Will post final summary when done. :white_check_mark:
